name: Kheru Spellsnatcher
oracle_text:
Morph {4}{U}{U} (You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its morph cost.)
When this creature is turned face up, counter target spell. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost for as long as it remains exiled.
blocked_sentences: When this creature is turned face up, counter target spell. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost for as long as it remains exiled.

needs.what: a trigger event for this permanent being turned face up (source: self), so a morph creature's 'When this creature is turned face up, ...' ability goes on the stack when its morph cost is paid
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The engine's _turn_face_up emits a 'turned_face_up' event, but it is not in the packet's trigger_events vocabulary, so no triggered ability can listen for it; self_enters does not fire on turning face up (the permanent is already on the battlefield), and ability_activated / becomes_untapped are different events

needs.what: counter target spell, exiling it instead of the graveyard, and give the trigger's controller permission to cast that exiled card without paying its mana cost for as long as it remains exiled (playable: while_exiled, playable_free: true on the countered card)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: counter carries exiles and as, but its op_options list no playable / playable_free; it may be expressible as counter (exiles, as) followed by grant_playable with playable_free and playable 'while_exiled' over the bound card, but that is unverified and moot until the trigger event exists
